browser.description: Chrome browser launch and lifecycle settings

viewport.description: Window size: "WIDTHxHEIGHT" (e.g. 1280x720), "maximized" (1920x1080 in headless), or empty for Chrome default

display.description: Linux only: fallback DISPLAY value when unset (e.g. ":0")

extraArgs.description: Extra command-line flags passed to Chrome

browserUrl.description: Existing Chrome CDP HTTP or WebSocket URL (skips launching or closing Chrome)

idleTimeout.description: Auto-close idle browser/daemon after duration (e.g. "30m", "1h", "300s") or "never" / 0

evaluateScript.description: Rewrite inline evaluate_script functions so stack traces hide pptr: and local paths

sourceUrl.description: Source URL token shown in rewritten evaluate_script stack traces

disable_update_check.description: Disable CLI update checks and cached update/announcement reminders
